## Don't do this again

- Track items as a list and scan per add - reason: Name-keyed dict keeps merges O(1); list scanning resurfaces per line (rejected in L-0006)
- Render the receipt as HTML directly - reason: The demo is terminal-only; HTML invites injection issues (rejected in L-0004)
- Return (subtotal, discount) and let the UI compute totals - reason: Pushes arithmetic to every caller; totals become inconsistent across views (rejected in L-0003)
- Hardcode the tax rate as a module constant - reason: Rates differ per store; a settable field keeps the module reusable (rejected in L-0002)
